node.title: Re: User name character classes (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You could use [doc://perlunicode#User-Defined-Character-Properties] ([https://bitbucket.org/haukex/htools/src/5a8a44b48c752bd6e61a6f78bf78394353e9f9f1/enctool#enctool-394|example]).

Update:

sub IsConsonant () { "42 44 46 48 4A 4E 50 54 56 58 5A 62 64 " ."66 68 6A 6E 70 74 76 78 7A " } sub IsVowel () { "41 45 49 4F 55 59 61 65 69 6F 75 79 " } print "CVC word found : $1 " if / (\p{IsConsonant}\p{IsVowel}\p{IsConsonant}) /;

Update 2: Code you can use to generate sets like the above:

use warnings; use strict; use Data::Dump; use Set::IntSpan; my @chars = grep {!/^[aeiouy]$/i} 'a'..'z','A'..'Z'; dd join '', map { no warnings 'redundant'; sprintf $$_[0]==$$_[1] ? "%X " : "%X %X ", @$_ } Set::IntSpan->new( map {ord} @chars )->spans; __END__ "42 44 46 48 4A 4E 50 54 56 58 5A 62 64 66 68 6A 6E 70 74 76 78 7A "
